strategy: one unchanged initial input per case, sequential; at most one factual answer revision to actual model questions; preserve all revisions and failures
follow_up: only matching prepared synthetic cards; unknown facts remain unknown; no manual rewriting of model output
isolation: separate SQLite DB/source directory per case; existing views, prompts, transport and validations unchanged
test_envelope: 5 USD shared ledger; conservative reservation before each call; no application quota bypass
stop: no invented scope confirmations, cause validation, preferred solution, governance approval, pilot result or operational release
evaluation: source grounding, scope/focus fit, facts versus hypotheses, uncertainty, solution neutrality only if reached, provenance, counted intervention events; human minutes unmeasured
sampling_limit: four qualitative cases, no reliability rate or generalized model ranking
plan_record: recorded during execution; strategy announced to user before calls, not a formally preregistered experiment
observed_deviation: C and D clarification runs overlapped; complete ledgers reconciled without a rerun; exclusive starter lock added and tested
